# cpanel_dns_record (Data Source)

Looks up one DNS record by zone and cPanel line index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_dns_record" "verification" {
  zone       = "example.com"
  line_index = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `line_index` (Number) The current zero-based line index of the record in the cPanel DNS zone.
- `zone` (String) The cPanel-managed DNS zone without a trailing dot.

### Read-Only

- `data` (List of String) The ordered DNS record data fields.
- `name` (String) The record name relative to the zone, or `@` for the zone apex.
- `ttl` (Number) The DNS record time to live in seconds.
- `type` (String) The DNS record type.
